$comment: Tests that may be skipped in CI, per runner OS. verify-skips.mjs fails the job when any other test
is skipped, so a missing tool or a broken skip condition can't quietly turn a check green.
An entry with "test" allows that one test (its full name: describe titles + test title, separated by spaces).
An entry without "test" allows any test in that file to skip; use it only for tests that depend on a
tool the runner doesn't have. Every entry needs a reason. Allowed is not required: a test that runs is fine.

linux.test: analyzeReference on PLANNING_REFERENCE_VIDEO analyses the editor's own file and builds a profile from it
linux.reason: Opt-in: runs only when PLANNING_REFERENCE_VIDEO points at a real reference video on the developer's machine. CI has synthetic media only.

linux.test: Unicode model paths on Windows transcribes end to end with the model and work folder under a Unicode user folder
linux.reason: Windows only (8.3 short paths and hard links for non-ASCII model paths). Runs in the Windows job.
